encoding.approach: isinstance is a runtime type-dispatch on a live object, not in the harvested op-surface (boolean/compare/arith/bit/unary/conditional). It cannot be encoded as a boolean/integer expression over cli/yaml/int/bool inputs. Modeled as a finite EnumSort over the two seeded rhs values with a hand-supplied is_parameter(v) := (v == Parameter_x_1) type-tag mapping. Z3 then trivially partitions the enum; this is a MIRROR of the type predicate under the seeded assumption, NOT a proof over Python's type system.
encoding.smt2_sketch: (declare-datatypes () ((Rhs Parameter_x_1 int_1))) (declare-const rhs Rhs) (define-fun is_parameter ((v Rhs)) Bool (= v Parameter_x_1)) ; pred = (is_parameter rhs)

runtime_confirmation.method: Executed in-container (tl-char) against the real Tensile.Configuration.Parameter class.

notes: Guard predicate of Parameter.__le__. isinstance(rhs, Parameter) selects between two return expressions that are SEMANTICALLY EQUIVALENT in their comparison (self.value <= rhs.value vs self.value <= rhs); the guard only normalizes a Parameter rhs to its .value before comparing. The predicate itself depends on the runtime type of rhs, so classification=runtime-dependent / solver_status=unknown. Both branches are reachable (witnesses runtime-confirmed). No pure helper extracted: isinstance is irreducibly a type/runtime probe with no boolean/integer decomposition. CrossHair not run (no pure boolean/int helper to check).
